rules.when: trivial: one file, an obvious mechanical change (docs, rename, lint, version bump, config tweak)
rules.why: nothing to decide; low effort preserves the 5-hour usage window

rules.when: broad: a feature or refactor touching many files, a code migration between APIs, extensive tests
rules.why: the task is understood but long; raise effort before raising the model

rules.when: ambiguous: a bug with no known cause, an intermittent failure, an investigation or a design decision with trade-offs
rules.why: the problem is judgment, so raise the model; Sol medium is the recommended starting point for investigations

rules.when: sensitive or long and unattended: security, auth, data migration, or hours-long work where a wrong direction is expensive
rules.why: top model with more verification; high is the sustainable ceiling on the subscription

rules.when: escalation: a task that already failed at another level because of a judgment error (not a vague brief)
rules.why: last resort; xhigh costs ~30% more time and tokens than medium with no gain on ordinary tasks
